subject: Straightline hosted API — senior rate consideration
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Straightline hosted API pricing concession request

Marcus —

Quick one: Straightline (Alex Gomez) is asking for a material concession on Hosted API unit pricing for a 12‑month commitment tied to their marketplace integration. Key details:
- Forecasted first year consumption: ~120M tokens/month (steady ramp).
- Current list unit price: $0.0008/token.
- AE ask: 30% off list (to $0.00056) to win their multi‑region pilot and marketplace distribution.
- Contract: 12 months, prefer monthly usage billing but open to prepaid.
- Revenue profile: ~$700K ARR in year 1 at our margins; long‑term upside via marketplace referrals and joint marketing.

Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW), straightline-usage-forecast.xlsx, discount-model.xlsx.

They've given a tight timeline — legal wants an answer within 48 hours to hit their vendor onboarding window. Ben

-- 
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Straightline hosted API pricing concession request

Tessa / Lauren — forwarding Ben's ask for senior consideration. TL;DR: AE asks for 30% off list for a 12‑month commit; timeline is tight (48h).

Why this matters:
- Straightline is a horizontal marketplace with outbound distribution potential; if we win the integration they plan to feature Redwood in their partner catalog (estimated +20% pipeline uplift for similar customers).
- They requested the deeper discount citing competitive pressure from two other vendors who quoted aggressive volume rates.

Risks / constraints:
- 30% is outside the standard delegation for Hosted API deals and meaningfully impacts unit economics even after expected upsell.
- We should condition any concession on concrete guardrails (prepay, minimum spend, or usage milestones).

Can you review and approve an exception? My recommendation: approve up to 22% if they prepay 12 months or provide a $250k annual minimum commitment; consider 25–30% only if we secure a marketplace/promotional commitment (written) that materially speeds adoption.

Ben — holding off on customer comms until we have senior signoff.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Deal Strategy
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Straightline hosted API pricing concession request

Marcus / Ben —

Thanks for the summary. I'm supportive of a controlled concession given the strategic upside, but we need to lock down commercial protections before committing to >20%. Proposed approval path: 

1) Approve up to 22% off list price (effective unit $0.000624) conditioned on BOTH:
   - 12‑month prepayment for year 1 (non‑refundable) OR a banked commit of $250,000 minimum; AND
   - A signed partner placement agreement guaranteeing Redwood placement in Straightline's partner marketplace and inclusion in one co‑marketing activity in Q3.

2) If customer will NOT prepay or provide a minimum, escalate to CFO for margin signoff.

3) Anything above 22% (25–30%) requires written confirmation from Straightline of a co‑marketing commitment + legal signoff on data residency language (they asked for EU hosting; that will require Private deployment review).

Please collect: SOW, final forecast (monthly), and a draft marketplace placement clause (I reviewed the SOW draft attached — add the placement language to section 4). If Ben can get the customer to prepay we can route the DocuSign quickly.

Approve: up to 22% with the stated conditions. Lauren please prep a conditional term amendment we can attach to the DocuSign.

Tessa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Straightline hosted API pricing concession request — senior decision

Ben —

Per Tessa: we can offer Straightline a 22% concession if they meet the commercial protections listed below. Please draft the offer and send to the customer with these conditions clearly called out:

- Discount: 22% off list price for Hosted API usage across the 12‑month term (unit price $0.000624/token).
- Payment: Full 12‑month prepayment required OR $250k minimum committed spend (invoiced monthly) with early termination fees to protect us.
- Placement: Signed partner marketplace placement (one guaranteed feature in partner catalog + one co‑marketing activity).
- Legal: Include standard Redwood data processing addendum; note that any EU hosting/data‑residency requests will be handled as a separate Private deployment line item and require additional approval.
- DocuSign: Send offer via DocuSign link (use template REDWOOD‑HOSTED‑STANDARD + conditional amendment).

Lauren — please attach the conditional term amendment (label: STRAIGHTLINE_COND_TERM_v1) and confirm the final DocuSign template id. Tessa — copying you for oversight; flag if finance/legal need to sign off beyond the stated conditions.

Ben, aim to get the signed DocuSign executed within 48 hours to hit their onboarding window.

Marcus
Director, Deal Strategy
Redwood Inference
